scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:logs
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict:stage1 && npm run typecheck:strict:stage2 && npm run typecheck:strict:stage3
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run eslint && npm run test
scripts.ci:gate:min: npm run typecheck && npm run eslint && npm run test && npm run strict:stage1
scripts.pretest: npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>nul || echo rebuild skipped (file locked)
scripts.electron:compile: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('electron/main.js.map');require('fs').unlinkSync('electron/preload.js.map')" && npx javascript-obfuscator electron/main.js --output electron/main.js --compact true --string-array true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal && node -e "var c=require('crypto'),f=require('fs');var h=c.createHash('sha256');h.update(f.readFileSync('electron/main.js'));f.writeFileSync('electron/main.js.hash',h.digest('hex'));console.log('main.js.hash written')"
scripts.electron:dev: chcp 65001 >nul && npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build && npm run server:build && npm run electron:compile && electron . && npm rebuild better-sqlite3
scripts.server:build: node scripts/build-server.cjs && node scripts/strip-console.mjs && node scripts/obfuscate-core.cjs && node scripts/write-hash.cjs
scripts.electron:build: npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build:prod && npm run frontend:obfuscate && npm run server:build && npm run ft:build-portable && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build:local: npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build:prod && npm run frontend:obfuscate && npm run server:build && npm run ft:build-portable && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:build:win: npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build:prod && npm run frontend:obfuscate && npm run server:build && npm run ft:build-portable && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish always
scripts.electron:build:mac: npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build:prod && npm run server:build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && npm run build:prod && npm run server:build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.postinstall: echo Skipping electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/copy-crypto-icons.cjs
